approved.reasoning: Correction against CS6-BS's order of 5 unit for RM 420 dated 2026-09-16 (s169). Sets cash from 420 to cleared, deliveredQty from 5 to cleared, handover from collected to cleared, cost from 240 to cleared, cancelled from false to true. It moves no cash and no stock: it changes what the row says about itself. The row is not rewritten here. The fold applies the patch, so there is one definition of what a correction does rather than two.
flags: A cost typed here overrides what the inventory says this row drew, and it is what every margin on the row is then measured against.
Cancelling takes this row out of every figure on the desk: the revenue, the stock it drew and anything owed on it.
CS6-BS typically pays about RM 107.5/unit for salt across 18 orders; this one is RM 84, 21.9% below that.
